# SplitBill

> Free, 100% private, offline-first web app for splitting restaurant bills using local OCR receipt scanning.

SplitBill allows users to scan restaurant receipts using on-device WebAssembly OCR, assign items to friends (including fractional portions like 0.5), and proportionally allocate taxes and discounts without rounding errors.

## Key Features
- **Local OCR**: No receipt images are sent to any server. Everything runs in the browser.
- **Zero Rounding Errors**: Uses the Largest Remainder Method in cents/paise.
- **No Registration**: 100% free with no paywalls or daily limits.
- **Progressive Web App**: Works entirely offline once loaded.
